function.name: computer_observe
function.description: Semantic desktop snapshot — exploration and recovery tool. Do NOT call it after actions with verificationHint indicating success (action results already carry post-state + changes). Only call computer_observe for initial screen discovery, unexpected dialogs, or when action status is ObservedChange or Unverified and concrete confirmation is needed.
